finding: The odds of achieving a vaginal delivery with balloon-mediated labour induction were similar to those with PGE(2) agents, while combining PGE(2) medications or using quadruple induction approaches led to poorer outcomes.
mod_finding: Balloon-mediated labour induction was associated with similar odds of vaginal delivery compared to PGE(2) agents, while combining PGE(2) medications or using quadruple induction approaches were associated with lower odds of vaginal delivery.
